title: Chris Vermeulen: Gold Could Drop To As Low As $3,100
speaker: Chris Vermeulen (The Technical Traders), interviewed by Daryl Thomas

macro_themes.view: 5-, 10- and 30-year yields above 5% have started a new secular bull market in yields that charts project to 8%+, driven by falling trust.
The yield breakout is not yet priced into stocks; within a month or several it should pressure equities and real estate and eventually start a bear market.
Treasury long-end buybacks are token amounts; a global deleveraging cannot be stopped by the Fed once it starts.
Rising yields are pulling foreign money into USD and US stocks; dollar could rise ~17%, pressuring metals.
Gold and silver are in stage-4 downtrends after an early-2026 blow-off top; a sharp drop would be a long-term buying opportunity.
Utilities and dividend stocks are down ~10% as cash yields compete with them; real estate faces difficult times.

calls.condition: Short term he expects yields to pause/pull back as 'overdone'; trend then resumes higher into year-end.
calls.reason: Monthly chart: 40-year downtrend reversed, moving averages crossed, fresh breakout above 5%; measured move points to 8%+ (5y and 30y show the same pattern).
calls.quote: what the charts are pointing to, they're they're pointing to eight plus percent on the 10-year

calls.reason: Same breakout pattern as the 10-year; he says the 30-year chart also points to 8%.
calls.quote: the five-year has the same chart pattern and it points to 8%. And the third here points to 8%

calls.condition: Counter-trend bounce/bear flag to ~80-81 at best, then lower if yields keep rising into year-end.
calls.reason: Down ~56% from peak, all moving averages sloping down; Oct 1 gap-down looks like an exhaustion move before a small bear-flag bounce; another 20-30% downside.
calls.quote: I think we're going to see this down around maybe 60 bucks a share

calls.condition: If yields and the dollar keep rising and equities crash, a sharp, short-lived flush to 3,100 is possible; he would buy there.
calls.reason: Stage-4 bear market: price below a falling 150-day MA after a euphoric blow-off top early 2026; Fibonacci measured move to 3,600 (~12% lower) over roughly a month.
calls.quote: the next downside measured move for gold based on Fibonacci is 3600

calls.reason: Same stage-4 bear market as gold (long-term MA down, price below); still points to about $39-40, which he would view as a long-term buying opportunity.
calls.quote: it's still pointing to about 40 or $39 per ounce

calls.reason: Rising yields are strengthening the dollar and foreign money is flowing into USD assets; he sees potential for a ~17% upside move, which would pressure metals.
calls.quote: We could see like a 17% move in the US dollar to the upside

calls.condition: Long now; but rising yields expected to become a major headwind over the next several months and eventually start an equity bear market.
calls.reason: Equities breaking out with nice trends and money flowing into stocks; his position strategy is long and expects an 8-10% move up.
calls.quote: We're longing the S&P 500 here. We've got some nice trends. I'm expecting, you know, an 8 10% move up

calls.condition: Same as ES: long for a FOMO leg (Anthropic IPO, tech/semis), but expects yields to eventually trigger a bear market.
calls.reason: Nasdaq breaking out to all-time highs after four months sideways since June; first target already hit, expects further upside on FOMO.
calls.quote: we're also longing the NASDAQ... we're expecting the markets to continue to go higher

calls.condition: If it tags 95,000, lock in profits / raise stops as it may reverse there.
calls.reason: Turned from stage-4 bear to bull market; successive bull flags point to a Fibonacci measured move and prior high at ~95,000 (~9% upside).
calls.quote: it's popping and it's building another bull flag and it's pointing to about 95,000

calls.condition: Take profits/close at 198-200, then wait for a bull flag to play the next leg.
calls.reason: Price above all moving averages in a bullish environment; 200 is a prior high, a round number and the next Fibonacci measured move, so strong resistance.
calls.quote: if MSTR hits 198, 199, 200, like lock in some profits or just close it out

calls.condition: Once the monthly uptrend (5-period MA) breaks, expects a big correction to around $5; in a recession it would crash with everything else.
calls.reason: Choppy monthly uptrend near all-time highs with a strong fundamental story already priced in; trend still up.
calls.quote: the trend is up and um, you got to expect it's going to continue to to chop its way higher

calls.reason: Agrees miners will come under pressure as gold, silver and copper fall.
calls.quote: But I wonder if the the uh miners are going to come under pressure ... >> They will.

notes: No date stated on air; 'NASDAQ hitting all-time highs today as you and I are speaking' suggests intraday recording near the listing date 2026-10-07. Prices for gold/BTC at time of call not stated: 3,600 is described as ~12% lower (implies gold ~4,090) and 95,000 as ~9% upside (implies BTC ~87,000). '30 years over 5 1.5%' (garbled) and 'the third here' read as the 30-year. GDX call is generic 'miners', not a quoted instrument. ES/NQ long-term 'bearish' reflects his expectation that yields eventually trigger a bear market 'over the next several months'.
